response.original_title: [Changing-Guidelines^] Can I change my cabin or room on Windstar Cruises Full Process Explained
response.overview: Yes, ☎+1-866 829-1280(US) you can change your cabin or room on Windstar Cruises. You can switch to an available cabin or room in the same category, request an upgrade, ☎+1-866 829-1280(US) or submit a bid for a higher state cabin or room tier. You cannot easily switch cabin or rooms online yourself without canceling and re-booking. You can upgrade or switch cabin or rooms by calling Windstar Cruises at +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK), using their website, or contacting your travel agent. Last-minute changes +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) on the day of sailing are generally not accommodated.
